name: OptScale Kompressor
summary: OptScale's cache-preserving request compressor, run as a proxy. Held and watched: the only result is vendor-run on Codex (cost -22.7%, solve rate 81.1% against 82.2%), and the proxy puts it in the request path, which v8 doesn't allow.

evidence.source: https://optscale.ai/blog/context-compression-coding-agents (OptScale blog: context compression for coding agents), with https://github.com/hystax/optscale-kompressor

egress.default: every request passes through its proxy (where the proxy runs wasn't reviewed)

revisit: ships without a proxy, with independent evidence
maintenance: Vendor repository created 2026-10-14; release cadence not reviewed.
